WITH media_type_ratios AS (
  SELECT mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name,
         AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / t.Milliseconds) AS bytes_per_millisecond
  FROM MediaType AS mt
  JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId
  GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name
)
SELECT Name,
       bytes_per_millisecond,
       bytes_per_millisecond / AVG(bytes_per_millisecond) OVER () AS ratio_to_average
FROM media_type_ratios;
